label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
**To everyone who's been messaging me since Saturday (and anyone this gets forwarded to)**

Hi everyone,

First things first: I'm okay. Marmalade is okay. I'm staying with my sister in Rondebosch for now and I'm safe, fed, and very well looked after.

My phone hasn't stopped since Saturday night and I've been trying to reply to everyone, but I'm exhausted and I just can't keep up. So I'm writing this once, properly, so you all have the same information. Please feel free to forward it on to anyone who's been asking.

**What happened (the short version)**

On Saturday night, 7 November, at around 11:40pm, a fire started in one of the ground floor flats at Lindale Court on Station Road in Obs. That's my building. It wasn't my flat; I'm on the second floor, in flat 12.

All 14 flats got out. Everyone. Two people were treated for smoke at Groote Schuur and sent home the same night. When I think about how differently it could have gone, that's the part I keep holding on to.

The fire department thinks it was probably an electrical fault, but they're still investigating, so I'm not going to guess or add anything to that. Please don't pass on rumours about how it started. There are a lot of us in that building and it doesn't help anyone.

The reason I woke up at all is Uncle Faizel, our neighbour, who went down our whole floor banging on every single door in his vest and slippers. I don't really have words for what I owe him. I grabbed my phone and Marmalade and nothing else. Marmalade then hid under a car for two hours afterwards and refused to come out, which I suppose is fair.

My flat is basically gone. There's smoke and water damage through everything, and the ceiling in the lounge came down. The landlord says nobody will be allowed back in for at least six weeks, probably longer, so I'm going to have to find somewhere new.

I keep telling myself that furniture can be replaced. Marmalade can't. I'm okay with that trade.

**Please read this part: there is a FAKE fund going around**

A few of you have sent me links to a "Thandi Fire Relief" page on some other site, and there's also a WhatsApp message going round asking people to EFT money to a Capitec account. **That is not me.** I didn't set it up, I don't know who did, and I've reported it.

I will never ask anyone to EFT money to a personal account over WhatsApp. If you get a message like that, please don't send anything, and please let whoever forwarded it to you know it's a scam. It makes me feel sick that someone would do this to people who are just trying to be kind.

**The real fundraiser**

My friend Zinhle set up a BackaBuddy page for me. This is the **only** real one:

**backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court**

The target is R25 000, and when I checked this morning it was already at R11 400. I honestly sat and cried looking at that number.

I'll be honest with you: I hate asking for help, and I felt really weird about having a fundraiser at all. Zinhle basically told me to shut up and accept it. So I'm accepting it. Please don't feel any pressure to give. If you can, thank you so much. If you can't, sharing the correct link (and warning people about the fake one) helps just as much.

**What I actually need**

People keep asking what they can do, so here's the honest list:

- **Help with a deposit for a new place.** This is the big one, and it's mostly what the fundraiser is for.
- **School shoes and work clothes.** I'm a size 6 in shoes and a size 34 in clothes. Mostly practical stuff I can wear to work and get paint and glue on.
- **A laptop**, if anyone has an old one sitting in a drawer that still works. All my lesson planning was on mine and it's gone. It doesn't need to be fancy at all. If you have one, please send me a message and I'll sort out getting it from you.

**What I don't need (please!)**

- **More clothes in general.** I genuinely have too many already. People have been so generous that I'm going to pass the extras on to the other families from the flats, because I'm not the only one who lost things.
- **Food.** My sister's freezer is completely full. We could probably feed the whole of Lindale Court at this point.

I know it can feel strange to be told "no thanks" when you're offering something kindly, so please don't take it the wrong way. I'd just rather the help goes where it's actually needed.

**For the Little Acorns families**

To all the Ladybirds parents, and the rest of the Little Acorns family: thank you. I've felt so held by you this week.

One of the moms dropped a bag of clothes at my sister's gate at 7am on Sunday. She didn't even knock, just left it there and went. I don't know if she wanted me to know it was her, so I won't say who, but if you're reading this: thank you. That bag got me through Sunday.

A few practical things:

**The concert on 27 November is still happening.** Please don't worry. I lost everything I'd taken home to laminate, including all 22 crowns and the kids' handprint banner, which honestly broke my heart a little. But the Ladybirds WILL have crowns on the day. We'll make it work. Whatever happens, they'll be up on that stage looking like royalty.

**I'm back at school on Wednesday.** I have one big favour to ask: please don't make a big thing of it in front of the children. They're four and five, and I don't want them scared or worried about their teacher. If your little one has heard something and asks about it, a simple "Teacher Thandi's flat got damaged but she and her cat are safe" is more than enough. I just want to walk into class and have a normal morning with them. Honestly, I think that's going to be the best thing for me too.

If you'd like to chat to me about anything, I'm always happy to have a quiet word at pickup. Just maybe not in the middle of the classroom.

**About replying**

I'm going to be very slow replying to comments and messages for a while. Please don't be offended if I don't answer your DM. I've read them, I promise. I've been crying at pretty much every single one. I just don't have the energy right now to reply to everyone, and I'd rather send you this than leave you wondering.

**Thank you**

I don't really know how to end this except to say thank you. To Uncle Faizel, to the fire department, to my sister for taking in me and a very traumatised cat, to Zinhle for refusing to take no for an answer, to the school families, to my friends, and to people I've never even met who've sent kind words and shared the page.

It's been a horrible few days, but I've never felt so looked after. You've all been amazing.

Lots of love,
Thandi (and Marmalade)

---

**Please share the real link only:** backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court
**Ignore:** any "Thandi Fire Relief" page or any WhatsApp asking for an EFT to a Capitec account.

---

A couple of quick notes:

- I left out a way for people to reach you about the laptop other than "send me a message," since you said you're not answering DMs much. If you'd rather people go through Zinhle or your sister, just swap that line.
- You said you're "back at school on Wednesday," and today is Wednesday. If you mean next Wednesday, you might want to put the date in (18 November) so nobody's confused.
